Turning a guest request into a recurring group arrangement

Pricing an incentive around a clear commitment, and building a lasting customer relationship.

The objective

A guest asked a vacation-rental business for a discount, explaining that he could bring together other parents who travelled each summer to the same region for their children’s sports tournaments. The business operated on low margins.

Raju’s contribution

Raju, who had responsibility for such decisions, offered the guest preferential pricing on condition that he provided a commitment of at least 50 rooms. In later years he continued to offer a preferential arrangement on the same condition.

The outcome

The arrangement began in 2017 and continued in later years. 2026 is expected to be its final year. According to Raju, it brought summer business that the company would otherwise not have had, and a lasting relationship with the guest.

Source: Raju Lalwani’s account.

The experience this brings

Structuring a commercial incentive around a clear commitment, and building customer relationships that bring repeat business.
